tests_pass.notes: make test exit 0; ailang test --package . green (98/98 per PR, re-run clean); CI on the PR green

lint_clean.notes: No separate lint target; no warnings from ailang check/run. No Python added.

acceptance_criteria.notes: AC16 (markers_test), AC7-part (make strict-ai: digest 96e6505d77f95e50, strict VM == interpreter, emotion list == emotion_styles.json keys in order), make test, one-line Makefile diff all verified. make markers-mutants: 3/3 killed by the named tests.

code_quality.notes: markers.ail is pure and runs on the strict VM; deterministic; cites ailang#1503 (confirmed OPEN) at the workaround site. -1: zero-width space accepted as visible text; token recursion is unbounded on the strict VM (see findings).

documentation.notes: Sprint JSON, sprint-plan status and PR body are accurate. CHANGELOG.md not touched (landing step per CLAUDE.md, so only a small deduction); design doc stays in planned/ until the sprint lands.

design_fidelity.notes: 8 emotions in D-7 order, {emotion} syntax (D-20), all six ai_markup sub-reasons, leading neutral, merge, trim, 16 after merge, fallback table exactly as planned.

adversarial_probes.errors: }{ -> unbalanced_brace; {{ -> nested_brace; {} , {HAPPY}, {Neutral}, {happy }, { neutral} -> unknown_emotion; {happy}{happy}x, trailing marker, whitespace-only segment, empty and blank line -> empty_segment; {h{a}p}, {happy}{{sad}}x -> nested_brace; 'a}b' and stray '{' -> unbalanced_brace; brackets win over everything else
adversarial_probes.unicode: CJK, emoji, accented text parse; idempotent; NBSP and ideographic space trimmed; U+200B alone is NOT trimmed (accepted as a segment); tab/newline/CR inside text kept or trimmed at ends only
adversarial_probes.segments: 16 segments pass, 17 refused; 16 doubled (32 markers) merge to 16 and pass; 17 doubled refused; 300 equal markers merge to one segment
adversarial_probes.idempotence: printLine(parseLine(x)) re-parsed and re-printed is identical on all ~25 accepted probes; printLine of a parsed line is a fixed point
adversarial_probes.display_text: never contained { or } on any accepted probe (braces inside text are refused by the lexer)
adversarial_probes.long_lines: 200000 chars OK on the interpreter (needs raised recursion depth beyond ~10000 chars? no: 9000 passes at default); strict VM handles 4000 chars and 400 markers
adversarial_probes.casing: case-sensitive; any capitalised or padded name is unknown_emotion

survived: TText(_) => Err("unbalanced_brace") -> Err("empty_segment") in segText: equivalent, unreachable because the lexer never emits two texts in a row
merge guard '&& p.text != ""': equivalent, segment text is never empty after the trim check
own_mutations.killed_examples: trim removal, lex(trim(line)), merge separator, >= vs >, 16->15, fallback chain edits, display separator, printLine marker, nested/unbalanced swaps, leading-text default, isEmotion check, pickPortrait membership

deviation_verdicts.sim_ailang_toml_exports: ACCEPT. Required for ./markers import (the build fails otherwise); one-line change. Nit: no space before the next entry, harmless. Expect a trivial conflict with AI.2.
deviation_verdicts.markers_mutants_target: ACCEPT. Makes the plan's mutation AC a command; fails on anchor drift; correctly kept out of ai-test. Good design.
deviation_verdicts.error_precedence: ACCEPT. bracket first, then lexer faults left to right, then unknown_emotion/empty_segment in token order, then too_many. Documented in the header; matches D-20's list.
deviation_verdicts.empty_trimmed_segment_is_empty_segment: ACCEPT. Sensible and tested ({happy}   {sad}Hi). Only gap is U+200B (see non-blocking 1).
deviation_verdicts.case_sensitive_names: ACCEPT. Strict is right for a machine-emitted grammar; tested ({Happy}, {HAPPY}).
deviation_verdicts.fallbackChain_includes_self: ACCEPT. pickPortrait needs the emotion itself first; the plan's table lists the successors, and the chain for angry/fearful/curious is [e, neutral]. Unknown names yield [neutral] (tested by mutation).
deviation_verdicts.ailang_1503_workaround: ACCEPT. Issue is filed and open, workaround is small and cited at the site.

non_blocking_findings: sim/markers.ail segText/segments: U+200B (zero-width space) and similar invisible characters survive trim, so '{happy}<U+200B>' is a valid segment with no visible text. If the AI service can emit them, AI.2 ai_markup validation may want an invisible-only check. Not in AC16.

sim/markers.ail (lexChar, segText, afterMark, mergeOnto, count): all recursion is per character or per token and unbounded. Fine for real lines; the strict VM overflowed in my probes only for 1000+ repetitions of the generating helper, and the parser itself handled 400 merging markers and 4000 characters. AI.2's ai_length cap should bound the body before parseLine runs.
CHANGELOG.md has no AI.1 entry; add at landing.
The mutants for the two equivalent survivors suggest tiny dead branches (TText after TText); could be collapsed, not required.
evaluator_notes: Merge-ready from the evaluator's side. The probe files I wrote were deleted and are not part of the branch.
